name: Dungeon Tracer
detailed_description:
Dungeon Tracer

An easy-to-learn, deeply strategic puzzle RPG
Connect tiles with simple and intuitive controls to battle enemies, collect items, and build your own set of skills and equipment.
Survive as long as you can in ever-changing dungeons that offer a new layout every time you play.

Dungeon Tracer blends classic puzzle mechanics with the depth and replayability of a roguelike RPG.

Features

Build your own strategy

Every upgrade and item choice is yours to make.
Will you link swords to eliminate enemies quickly, focus on shields for survival,
or craft powerful skill combos to gain the upper hand?
Each decision leads to a completely different playstyle.

Unlock jobs and mix with races

Begin as an adventurer and unlock 9 unique classes, each with distinct traits and skill trees.
Combine them with 9 playable races to create new strategies and explore different approaches to dungeon survival.

Full Release Features

  • Four Difficulty Levels
    Choose from casual gameplay to highly strategic challenges.

  • Over 400 Items
    Discover and upgrade a wide range of gear to enhance your combat capabilities.

  • 40 Unique Abilities
    Mix and match offensive, defensive, and utility skills to suit any situation.

  • 20 Upgrade Paths
    Customize your items with special effects and enhancements tailored to your playstyle.

  • 40 Special Monsters
    Face off against powerful enemies with unique patterns and behaviors.

  • 9 Playable Classes
    Unlock and level up distinct classes, each with their own gameplay mechanics.

  • Global Ranking System
    Compete with players from around the world for high scores and leaderboard positions.

  • Always Save & Resume
    Pause anytime and pick up right where you left off.

Randomized dungeons.

Hundreds of build combinations.

Survive in your own way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570T (2 cores, 2.9 GHz), or AMD A10-5800K equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 (2GB) or Radeon HD 7850 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K (Intel Core i5-4570T (2 cores, 2.9 GHz), or AMD A10-5800K equivalent6 * 3600), or equivalent. AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (4 * 3500, or equivalent.)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 (2GB) or Radeon HD 7850 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Catalina 10.15 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M (Rosetta supported for Intel builds)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3.0+ compatible (2.1 with extensions may work)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
